lines.text: Roll three dice and sort them. How often is the middle one a two?
lines.caption: Roll three dice and sort them. How often is the middle one a two?

lines.text: Most kids say one in six. That's NOT right!
lines.caption: Most kids say one in six. That's NOT right!

lines.text: Three fair dice are rolled and put in order.
lines.caption: Three fair dice are rolled and put in order.

lines.text: What is the probability that the middle one is two?
lines.caption: What is the probability that the middle one is two?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Sort the rolls by how many dice show a two.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Sort the rolls by how many dice show a two.

lines.text: Exactly one two: the others are a one and a bigger number. That's twenty-four rolls.
lines.caption: Exactly one two: the others are a one and a bigger number. That's twenty-four rolls.

lines.text: Exactly two dice show a two: fifteen rolls. All three: just one.
lines.caption: Exactly two dice show a two: fifteen rolls. All three: just one.

lines.text: Twenty-four plus fifteen plus one is forty, out of two hundred sixteen.
lines.caption: Twenty-four plus fifteen plus one is forty, out of two hundred sixteen.

lines.text: That's five over twenty-seven. Choice C!
lines.caption: That's five over twenty-seven. Choice C!
